name: skill-diagnostics
description: Audits Claude skills against the official best practices and gates them: five validation scripts, four independent reviewers, a cold executor and an adversarial verifier give one report with file-and-line evidence and one verdict, and a gate has Claude audit every skill it creates or changes before it finishes.

on_skill_write.title: When a skill is written
on_skill_write.description: What happens after Claude creates or changes a skill: gate (Claude audits it before it finishes its turn), suggest (Claude offers an audit) or off.
